sacraments.text: Usually the second Sunday at 14:15 in the Main Church; parishioners first; register a month ahead. Coming dates: 11 October (full), 8 November, 11 December. Parents and godparents briefing one week before, 14:15, La Storta Room, Level 3. At least one practising Catholic parent; at most two godparents, one male and one female, confirmed practising Catholics aged 16 or over. Children aged 7–16 need catechetical formation first.
sacraments.contact: Brian Ling info@brianling.com; Lisa Ling sflchoo@yahoo.com; csi.catechetical@catholic.org.sg

sacraments.text: Adult baptism through RCIA, youth 16–25 through RCIY; detailed pages linked from baptism page.
Office during office hours, Sacristan Therese on weekends. PaCES provides home/hospital visits, prayer, Holy Communion and anointing arrangements for housebound elderly/sick.

Call Maria/Suzie for appointment. Complete application, baptism certificate, NRIC, cheque to Church of St Ignatius and death certificate if applicable. Family/community niches and memorial plaques available.
Contact Sacristan Therese for wedding bookings or wakes, funerals and interment.
